module purpose: The RTL stores four 32-bit CSR-written words in key_mem, returns a selected stored word on csr_rdata_o, and, when start_i and rtype_i qualify, captures rs1_i and rs2_i, updates internal done/sum/result state from funct3_i and the stored words, and drives result_o and valid_o. active_i, funct7_i, and rs3_i are declared but unused in this file.

use-case flows.value: a 32-bit CSR word written into one of the four stored key_mem slots
the csr_addr_i-selected stored word returned on csr_rdata_o
accepted operation start captures rs1_i and rs2_i and raises the internal done state for an r3type operation
sum and result state updated from the latched operands, funct3_i, and a stored key_mem word selected from xtea.sum
reported result_o and valid_o selected from rtype_i, funct3_i, xtea.res, and xtea.done
key_mem and xtea state cleared to zero while rstn_i is low

conceptual assets.concept: Four 32-bit CSR-programmed words stored in key_mem
conceptual assets.reasoning: The configure flow writes csr_wdata_i into key_mem at line 179 under csr_we_i (line 178), the read-out flow returns the selected stored word on csr_rdata_o at line 185, and the operate flow reads key_mem into tmp_z at lines 236-237 before tmp_r is formed at line 238. Corrupting these stored words changes both CSR readback and the later reported computation, so Integrity is established; availability is also established because the words are retained between clocked writes and reset to zeros at line 176.

conceptual assets.concept: Latched first operand word captured from rs1_i
conceptual assets.reasoning: The start flow copies rs1_i into xtea.opa at line 205 when start_i and rtype_i qualify at line 204. The stored word is then used to initialize xtea.sum at line 214 and to form tmp_a/tmp_b/tmp_x/tmp_y at lines 232-235, which feed tmp_r at line 238 and xtea.res at lines 222-224. If this captured operand is corrupted, the reported computation becomes incorrect, establishing Integrity; availability is also established because the register holds the accepted operand until it is used.

conceptual assets.concept: Latched second operand word captured from rs2_i
conceptual assets.reasoning: The start flow copies rs2_i into xtea.opb at line 206 when start_i and rtype_i qualify at line 204. The stored word is then used to form tmp_a/tmp_b/tmp_x/tmp_y at lines 232-235, which feed tmp_r at line 238 and xtea.res at lines 222-224. Corrupting this captured operand makes the later reported result incorrect, establishing Integrity; availability is also established because the register holds the accepted operand until it is used.

conceptual assets.concept: Running sum state used to select stored words and form the next arithmetic step
conceptual assets.reasoning: The operate flow updates xtea.sum from xtea.opa at line 214, by addition with xtea_delta_c at line 216, or by subtraction at line 218, all under xtea.done(0) at line 211. That state selects which key_mem word becomes tmp_z at lines 236-237 and is also used directly in tmp_r at line 238. A wrong sum state therefore breaks subsequent state evolution and reported results, establishing Integrity; availability is also established because xtea.sum is held across clock cycles and reset to zero at line 196.

conceptual assets.concept: Reported result word for the selected operation class
conceptual assets.reasoning: For the arithmetic funct3_i cases, xtea.res is updated as tmp_b plus or minus tmp_r at lines 221-224, and result_select forwards xtea.res to result_o at lines 247-250 when rtype_i selects the r3type path at line 245. On the other report branches, result_o is forced to zero at lines 252, 255, and 261. Integrity is established because the consumer-visible result must follow exactly these RTL branch and arithmetic relations; availability is also established under the stated branch conditions because the output is always driven by either xtea.res or a constant.

conceptual assets.concept: Reported validity decision for the selected operation
conceptual assets.reasoning: The internal done state is cleared and shifted at lines 200-201 and set on an accepted start at lines 204-207. result_select reports valid_o as xtea.done(1) for the arithmetic funct3_i cases at lines 247-250, as '1' for the init case at lines 251-253, and as '0' for the other cases at lines 254-262. Integrity is established because downstream logic depends on valid_o matching these exact conditions to accept or ignore result_o; availability is also established because the RTL always drives valid_o under those visible conditions.
